title: 第1章 她死在最爱她的人手里
lines: 像是有人拿着钝刀，一寸一寸在骨头里搅。
冷汗瞬间从额头滑落，喉咙里一阵腥甜，她几乎是本能地侧身，避开了那种要命的窒息感。
眼前不是医院白光，也不是实验室的无菌环境。
而是一间破旧潮湿的屋子。
霉味、灰尘、冷风，从四面八方灌进来。
窗纸破了一个大洞，风一吹，发出“哗啦哗啦”的响声。
无数不属于她的记忆，像刀一样刺入神经——
“连下人都可以踩一脚的存在。”
最后一幕，是一碗黑色的药，被强行灌入喉中。
手腕细白，却有一道极细的黑色针孔。
这毒不致命，但会一点点封死经脉，让人“自然废掉”，再被世界遗弃。
一个穿着华丽衣裙的少女站在门口，身后跟着两名丫鬟。
脸上是毫不掩饰的厌恶。
content_zh:
疼。

    像是有人拿着钝刀，一寸一寸在骨头里搅。

    苏晚猛地睁开眼。

    冷汗瞬间从额头滑落，喉咙里一阵腥甜，她几乎是本能地侧身，避开了那种要命的窒息感。

    眼前不是医院白光，也不是实验室的无菌环境。

    而是一间破旧潮湿的屋子。

    霉味、灰尘、冷风，从四面八方灌进来。

    窗纸破了一个大洞，风一吹，发出“哗啦哗啦”的响声。

    她愣了一瞬。

    下一秒，脑海炸开。

    无数不属于她的记忆，像刀一样刺入神经——

    相府。

    嫡女。

    苏晚。

    “废物。”

    “经脉阻滞，无法修习武道。”

    “相府耻辱。”

    “连下人都可以踩一脚的存在。”

    最后一幕，是一碗黑色的药，被强行灌入喉中。

    她死了。

    死在这具身体里。

    然后——她来了。

    苏晚缓缓抬起手。

    手腕细白，却有一道极细的黑色针孔。

    她盯着那一点黑。

    眼神一点点冷下去。

    “封脉毒。”

    她低声开口。

    不是猜测。

    是确认。

    这毒不致命，但会一点点封死经脉，让人“自然废掉”，再被世界遗弃。

    很温柔的杀人方式。

    也是很残忍的手法。

    她轻轻笑了一下。

    “有意思。”

    门外忽然传来脚步声。

    很重。

    带着毫不掩饰的轻蔑。

    “废物还没死？”

    “命真硬。”

    门被“砰”一声踹开。

    光线猛地灌进来。

    一个穿着华丽衣裙的少女站在门口，身后跟着两名丫鬟。

    脸上是毫不掩饰的厌恶。

    苏柔。

    苏晚脑海里自动浮现这个名字。

    相府庶女。

    最得宠的人。

    也是——原主“死亡”的直接推动者。

    苏柔捂着鼻子，嫌弃地看着她。

    “你还真能装死。”

    “昨夜那碗药喝下去，居然没死透。”

    她走进来一步，笑得很轻。

    “看来，下次要换剂量了。”

    空气安静了一瞬。

    苏晚缓缓坐起身。

    她动作很慢。

    但每一个细节，都不像一个“病弱废物”。
content_en:
pain.

    It was like someone was holding a dull knife and stirring the bones inch by inch.

    Su Wan opened her eyes suddenly.

    Cold sweat instantly fell from her forehead, and there was a sweet taste in her throat. She almost instinctively turned sideways to avoid the fatal suffocation feeling.

    What I see before me is not the white light of a hospital, nor is it the sterile environment of a laboratory.

    But a dilapidated and damp house.

    Musty smell, dust, and cold wind poured in from all directions.

    There was a big hole in the window paper, and when the wind blew, it made a "clattering" sound.

    She was stunned for a moment.

    The next second, my mind exploded.

    Countless memories that do not belong to her pierce her nerves like knives——

    Prime Minister's Mansion.

    Daughter.

    Su Wan.

    "Trash."

    "The meridians are blocked, making it impossible to practice martial arts."

    "The prime minister's house is a shame."

    "A being who can even step on a servant."

    The last scene is a bowl of black medicine being forcefully poured down the throat.

    She is dead.

    Die in this body.

    Then - she came.

    Su Wan slowly raised her hand.

    The wrist is thin and white, but there is a very thin black pinprick.

    She stared at the black spot.

    His eyes grew colder.

    "Pulse sealing poison."

    She spoke in a low voice.

    Not a guess.

    is confirmation.

    This poison is not fatal, but it will seal off the meridians bit by bit, causing people to "naturally become useless" and then be abandoned by the world.

    A very gentle way to kill.

    It's also a very cruel method.

    She smiled softly.

    "Interesting."

    Suddenly there were footsteps outside the door.

    Very heavy.

    With undisguised contempt.

    "The waste is not dead yet?"

    "Life is so hard."

    The door was kicked open with a bang.

    Light flooded in suddenly.

    A girl in a gorgeous dress stood at the door, followed by two maids.

    There was undisguised disgust on his face.

    Su Rou.

    The name automatically came to Su Wan's mind.

    The concubine of the prime minister's house.

    The most favored person.

    Also - the direct promoter of the original owner's "death".

    Su Rou covered her nose and looked at her with disgust.

    "You can really pretend to be dead."

    "After drinking that bowl of medicine last night, I actually survived."

    She took a step closer and smiled softly.

    "It seems that the dose will need to be changed next time."

    The air was quiet for a moment.

    Su Wan slowly sat up.

    She moves very slowly.

    But every detail does not look like a "sick waste".
title_en: Chapter 1 She died in the hands of the person who loved her most
